article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 18 Serial Broadcasts Dated Across Aunt Mary and Cecil and Sally
article-meta.kwd-group: Aunt Mary, Cecil and Sally, Daytime Serials, 1930s Radio, Original Filenames, Primary Scans

sec.title: Batch 10 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 10 resolves 18 historical serialized broadcasts from two of radio's most enduring narrative institutions: the 1942–1943 NBC Pacific Coast master recordings of ***Aunt Mary*** (sponsored by C&H Sugar, written by Gil Doud and Virginia Crosby) and the 1930 San Francisco transcription run of ***Cecil and Sally*** (starring Johnny Patrick and Helen Troy).

sec.title: 1. *Aunt Mary* — 1942–1943 NBC Pacific Coast Serial Dated
sec.p: Set in the rural community of Wakefield and Malibu Beach, *Aunt Mary* followed Mary Lane's guidance through wartime family crises:
sec.table: | Original Circulating Filename | Canonical Title | Verified Airdate | Storyline Arc | |---|---|---|---| | `Aunt_Mary_Pilot_Story_Of_Aunt_Mary.mp3` | **"Pilot: The Story of Aunt Mary (C&H Sugar Presentation)"** | **1942-10-19** | Initial audition pilot introducing Mary Lane and Bill Mead. | | `Aunt_Mary_Jessie_Suspicious_Of_Kitt.mp3` | **"Jessie Suspicious of Kitt's Motives"** | **1943-03-22** | Bill's loan consultation trip and David Bowman's bank inquiry. | | `Aunt_Mary_Jessie_Interrupts_Brett.mp3` | **"Jessie Interrupts Brett's Luncheon Date"** | **1943-03-23** | 11th Street confrontation between Jessie Calvert and Brett Cameron. | | `Aunt_Mary_Talking_Over_Kitts_Situation.mp3` | **"Talking Over Kitt's Situation"** | **1943-03-24** | Bill and Peggy Douglas return from the Wakefield Supper Club. | | `Aunt_Mary_Angus_Talks_To_Bill.mp3` | **"Angus Talks to Bill at the Wakefield Court"** | **1943-03-25** | Hysterical confrontation at the Wakefield Auto Court. | | `Aunt_Mary_Lisa_Learns_Kitt_Pregnant.mp3` | **"Lisa Learns Kitt Is Pregnant"** | **1943-03-26** | Sergeant Bill returns from military camp to face marriage disillusionment. | | `Aunt_Mary_Kitt_Wants_To_See_Lisa.mp3` | **"Kitt Wants to See Lisa at Malibu"** | **1943-03-29** | Living room confrontation with Paul Kramer at Malibu Beach. | | `Aunt_Mary_Lisas_Dream.mp3` | **"Lisa's Malibu Dream"** | **1943-03-30** | Heavy Pacific fog envelopes the Malibu beach house as dinner is prepared. | | `Aunt_Mary_Lisas_Baby_Born.mp3` | **"Lisa's Baby Born at Malibu Beach"** | **1943-03-31** | Sunny morning birth at Malibu Beach following dramatic labor. | | `Aunt_Mary_DA_Calls_Dr_Larrabee.mp3` | **"District Attorney Calls Dr. Larrabee at Huntsville"** | **1943-04-01** | Dr. Martin Larrabee, resident psychiatrist at Huntsville Sanitarium, is summoned. |

sec.title: 2. *Cecil and Sally* — 1930 San Francisco Master Discs Dated
sec.p: Johnny Patrick and Helen Troy wrote and voiced this daily 15-minute dialogue comedy for KPO San Francisco:
sec.table: | Original Circulating Filename | Canonical Title | Verified Airdate | Daily Comedy Arc | |---|---|---|---| | `Cecil_Sally_Mrs_Mason_Plans_To_Sue.mp3` | **"Mrs. Mason Plans to Sue Uncle Thomas"** | **1930-10-27** | Front-page newspaper scandal threatens Uncle Thomas. | | `Cecil_Sally_Sally_Has_Cecil_Cut_Hammock.mp3` | **"Sally Has Cecil Cut the Hammock Strings"** | **1930-10-28** | Hiding behind the porch drapery during the burning paper scare. | | `Cecil_Sally_Gertrude_Mason_Life_Story.mp3` | **"Gertrude Butterworth Mason Writes Her Life Story"** | **1930-10-29** | Sally discovers Mrs. Mason's tell-all memoir draft. | | `Cecil_Sally_Sally_Turns_Few_Words_Romance.mp3` | **"Sally Turns a Few Words Into a Deep Romance"** | **1930-10-30** | Misunderstandings multiply after late-night conversations. | | `Cecil_Sally_Willie_Comes_Over.mp3` | **"Willie Comes Over to Sally's House with Cecil"** | **1930-10-31** | Sally prepares her best living room impression for Willie. | | `Cecil_Sally_Cecil_Confides_In_Sally.mp3` | **"Cecil Confides in Sally"** | **1930-11-03** | Cecil seeks advice about his upcoming social engagement. | | `Cecil_Sally_Loves_Me_Loves_Me_Not.mp3` | **"Loves Me, Loves Me Not"** | **1930-11-04** | Evening stroll disputes and humorous pet dilemmas. | | `Cecil_Sally_Thinking_Arrested_Rewarded.mp3` | **"The Surprise Reward at the Boarding House"** | **1930-11-05** | Boarding house dining room confusion turns into a cash reward. |
